Georgia State ranks 8th on defense, allowing its opponents to convert at 25%. Old Dominion ranks 122nd in the FBS averaging 75.3 penalty yards per game, compared to Georgia State's 69th-ranked 57 per-game average. Both teams have strong red zone offenses. Old Dominion leads the FBS, scoring on 100% of red zone trips. Georgia State's red zone offense ranks 23rd at 94.7%. Old Dominion is 131st in the FBS with an average time of possession of 26:24, compared to Georgia State's 28th-ranked average of 32:40. Team leaders Old Dominion Passing: Quinn Henicle, 424 yards, 3 TDs, 2 INTs, 56.6 completion percentage Rushing: Henicle, 224 yards on 45 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: T.J. Johnson, 153 yards on 10 catches, 2 TDs Georgia State Passing: Cameran Brown, 873 yards, 6 TDs, 4 INTs, 67.6 completion percentage Rushing: Lanear McCrary Jr., 338 yards on 59 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Rodshaun Dorsey, 234 yards on 16 catches, 4 TDs Last game Old Dominion fell 46-20 to James Madison on Sept. 26. Ryan Huff threw for 261 yards on 20-of-39 attempts (51.3%) with one touchdown and one interception. Devin Roche had 18 rushing yards on eight carries, adding two receptions for 23 yards. Johnson put up 105 yards on five catches. Georgia State won 35-14 over Northern Illinois on Sept. 26. Brown led Georgia State with 148 yards on 14-of-21 passing (66.7%) for two touchdowns and one interception. McCrary had 111 rushing yards on 21 carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for nine yards. Dorsey recorded 114 yards on five catches with two touchdowns.
